errors.noRole: Your account signed in, but it is not in any group that Prunerr grants access to. Ask an administrator to add you to one of the mapped groups.
errors.provider: Prunerr could not reach the identity provider.
errors.state: That sign-in attempt expired or did not start here. Please try again.
errors.token: The identity provider returned a token Prunerr could not verify.
errors.unavailable: Single sign-on is not configured on this install.

footer: Access is configured by the server environment. See docs/authentication.md.
